question: Which option best represents the central theme of the passage?

options.text: hidden emotional struggles caused by digital beauty ideals

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage focuses on Meera’s struggle with distorted self-image due to unrealistic beauty standards promoted online.
 
• It highlights how digital platforms create pressure through filtered images and “perfect” bodies.
 
• The narrative emphasizes the hidden emotional battles teenagers face while trying to meet these standards.
 
• Therefore, the central theme revolves around the psychological impact of digital beauty norms.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Explanation:** *The passage primarily addresses how digital beauty illusions contribute to serious emotional and psychological struggles among teenagers.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1:** “the effects of peer pressure” – Peer pressure is not the main focus; the pressure is from digital beauty norms, not peers.
 
• **Option 2:** “trends in beauty and fashion” – This refers to external trends, not emotional struggles caused by them.
 
• **Option 4:** “the role of academic stress” – The passage does not discuss academic pressure at all.
